description: Record what a missed technical Level of Service target means, in the organization's own words. Advisory only: the statement is shown on the Status screen when a matching target is breached, and no notification is sent to notify_roles or to anyone else. When several match a breach the most specific scope wins (a specific system or feature class over a criticality tier over global). severity is a floor; the severity shown scales with the size of the gap and the facility's criticality. Requires los_consequences:write scope.

active.description: Whether the consequence is shown (default true)

metric.description: Limit to one metric; omit or null to match any metric

notify_roles.description: Roles named as owning the consequence. Recorded only; nothing is sent

scope_ref.description: What the scope points at: null for global; critical, high, medium or low for criticality_tier; a system ID (resolve first via list_systems) for system; a feature class code (resolve first via list_infrastructure_feature_classes) for feature_class. Required unless scope_type is global

name: create_los_consequence
title: Create LoS consequence
